body.x: SEOUL, Korea (AVING) -- <Visual News> Samsung Electronics unveils its eco-friendly LED display product lineup at the upcoming CES 2010 held in Las Vegas, which includes the company's upgraded LED monitors, LED digital photo frames, LED large format display and LED projectors.

Especially, Samsung will reveal its new high-tech LED monitor 'PX2370' featuring a transparent TV stand neck with the concept of 'Floating Design'. Adopting an illumination intensity sensor 'Magic Lux' on the front panel and 'Magic Angle' function to enlarge viewing angle, the PX2370 supports mega dynamic contrast ratio, 2ms response time, full HD resolution and 16:9 wide aspect ratio.

Samsung Electronics also unveils the industry's first LED LFD(Large Format Display) at the show, which comes in 46-inch and 55-inch size. Weighing only 15kg(46-inch model), the EXn series adopts a high-performance PC with a 40GB HDD and the company's content management system software 'MagicInfo'.
